introduction.title: Rule out keys before doing expensive work
paragraphs: A membership filter is a compact summary of a set. It can tell you that a value is definitely absent or might be present. Bitfilters builds these summaries from SQL columns and stores them as BLOBs that you can save and query later.

Use a filter to skip irrelevant partitions or reduce the rows sent into an expensive join. A possible match still needs an exact check because filters can produce false positives. The extension offers several filter families with different memory and update trade-offs.
